notes.title: Patch Notes — Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello hunters!

We’ve just released a new patch focused on fixing several issues and improving the overall experience. Here’s what's new:

[b]New Feature:[/b]
Added a "Reset Progress" button in the Settings menu.

[i]⚠️ Use with caution — this action is irreversible and will completely wipe your progress!
[/i]

[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with achievements where some boss achievements were not being unlocked correctly.
[*] Fixed a display issue where character stats appeared incorrectly in certain languages.
[*] Fixed item description errors that occurred in specific languages.
[*] Fixed two missing items that were not showing up properly in the Collection menu.
[*] Fixed an upgrade persistence issue where upgrades were not being saved correctly after abandoning a run.
[/list]
Thanks again for your support and feedback!
We’re committed to improving SideQuest Hunters and delivering the best experience possible.
If you encounter any more issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out to us through our official Discord!

Happy hunting! 🏹

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 — Achievement System and Major Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello hunters!

We’ve just released the SideQuest Hunters Update 1.1.0, and here’s what’s new:

🏆 Steam achievements are now available! Unlock achievements as you play.

🔨 Fixed a bug that caused stats to scale excessively at the highest forge levels.

🖥️ Aspect ratio issues fixed. The game now works properly on ultrawide and vertical monitors.

🛠️ Fixed a visual bug where the upgrade indicator in the forge appeared incorrectly.

📦 Reduced the overall game size for faster downloads and loading.

We've been carefully listening to your feedback and are committed to delivering the best experience possible.
If you find any other issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out to us through our Discord server!

Thank you for supporting us on this adventure! 🚀

notes.title: SideQuest Hunters is out now — Let the hunt begin!
notes.content:
After months of hard work and passion, SideQuest Hunters is finally out!
It’s an idle RPG with roguelike elements, automatic combat, constant progression, and meaningful choices that can change the course of your run.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193113/48a86904f8a9c93d9ef11ba07ffd84cf92d700a9.png[/img]

You can play it casually while doing other things, or go all-in and optimize every step — it's up to you.

A huge thanks to everyone who tried the demo, gave feedback, and supported us during development.
We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it!

We’re excited to announce that SideQuest Hunters just got a major visual update! Our cover art, logo, and key visuals have all been revamped to better reflect the epic adventure that awaits you in the game. And it’s all thanks to the incredibly talented [url=https://www.instagram.com/monkeybark/]monkeybark[/url], who has brought the world of SideQuest Hunters to life with her stunning illustrations. 💥⚔️

[h3]What’s New?
[/h3]We wanted the visuals to truly represent the fun, action-packed, and immersive experience that SideQuest Hunters offers. Here’s what’s changed:

[list]
[*] Brand New Cover Art: Featuring dynamic monster hunts and epic side quests.
[*] Updated Logo: Bold, adventurous, and perfectly fitting for a game where multitasking meets RPG.
[*] Revamped Key Visuals: Bringing the world of monster hunting to life with vibrant colors and detailed art.
[/list]
Check out the new art below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193113/bfed012ef4a05d1c042c16bd588016868afe018b.png[/img]

If you haven’t already, make sure to add SideQuest Hunters to your Steam Wishlist! By doing so, you’ll be the first to know about our release date, upcoming demo, and any future updates. 🚀

[h3]Follow Us for More Updates[/h3]
We’re also sharing sneak peeks, development news, and behind-the-scenes content on our social media platforms. Follow us to stay in the loop! 📲

[h3]Demo Coming Soon![/h3]

Thank you all for your incredible support—we can’t wait for you to experience the updated look of SideQuest Hunters and, of course, the epic adventures we have in store! ⚔️
